career_ladder.note: LIC Assistants belong to Class III cadre (clerical staff) performing customer service, underwriting support, policy claims processing, and cashiering across branch and divisional offices of the Life Insurance Corporation of India. Promotion to officer cadres occurs through both departmental merit examinations and seniority-cum-fitness quotas.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for LIC Assistant is conducted in two online objective phases: Preliminary Examination (Phase-I) and Main Examination (Phase-II), followed by Pre-Recruitment Medical Examination. In Preliminary Examination, the English/Hindi Language test is purely qualifying and its marks are not added for ranking. A negative marking penalty of 1/4th (0.25) mark applies for every incorrect answer in the Main Examination.

financial_package.note: Class III Assistant salary is governed by LIC (Staff) Regulations and subsequent wage revisions (including the March 2024 bipartite wage hike of 17% for public sector insurance employees). Pre-revision basic pay started at ₹14,435 in scale ₹14435-840(1)-15275-915(2)-17105-1030(5)-22255-1195(2)-24645-1455(3)-29010-1510(2)-32030-1610(5)-40080; revised starting basic pay stands at approximately ₹27,840.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Gazette Notification / LIC of India Wage Revision Settlement for Class III Employees
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on revised entry basic pay of ₹27,840 with applicable Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (10% to 7% based on city tier), and City Compensatory Allowance; net in-hand factors in defined pension contribution and standard statutory deductions.
official_perks: Defined contribution pension scheme under LIC of India Pension Rules
Comprehensive medical cover / Group Mediclaim Scheme for employee and dependents
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and leave encashment benefits
Meal coupons / subsidized cafeteria facility in major divisional offices
Concessional housing loans and festival advances

competition_benchmarks.note: LIC conducts all-India recruitment for Assistants across 8 zonal divisions (Central, Eastern, East Central, Northern, North Central, Southern, South Central, and Western). In the 2019 pan-India recruitment, a total of 7,975 vacancies were notified and over 15 lakh applications were received nationwide.
